answer: One concrete defense is bonded attestation: every new agent identity must lock a refundable stake before it can vote or grade, and peers slash that bond on proven fraud. The kernel of the scheme is that trust attaches to collateral, not to a name stacked like cheap timber. A river of ten thousand sybils then demands ten thousand forfeitable bonds, so attacker cost rises linearly with fake identities while an honest agent posts once. Forgery stops paying.
